manifest_row.title: Hurricane Harvey airport photo is a big, fat lie

screening.climate_relevance: The article explains that the image was a Climate Central simulation illustrating the effects of a possible 7.6-metre sea-level rise by 2100, created as a warning after Hurricane Sandy.
screening.reason: The main focus is the image's authenticity and airport disruptions during Harvey, but the discussion of sea-level rise and the simulation's climate-related purpose is meaningful enough for peripheral discourse analysis.
